label: External dependency alert
description: 504s on checkout confirm, caused by the external fraud-scoring call.

evidence.title: checkout-web: fraud-scoring-eu upstream timeout
evidence.detail: POST /v2/checkout/confirm blocks on the external fraud-scoring call (upstream timeout after 8000ms). External dependency timeout rate 38% for 2m.

evidence.title: checkout-web degraded; fraud-scoring-eu unhealthy; all internal dependencies healthy
evidence.detail: checkout-web status=degraded. fraud-scoring-eu status=unhealthy (38% timeout rate, p95 8020ms, provider status page confirms partial outage). redis-cache 1.0ms, postgres-orders 8.0ms - both healthy.

hint: The dependency graph already answers this. Do not restart anything yet.

label: Provider degradation confirmed
description: Provider timeout rate and retries confirmed; the rest of the system is idle and healthy.

evidence.title: fraud-scoring-eu degraded: 38% timeouts, p95 8020ms, circuit breaker half-open
evidence.detail: The circuit breaker is half-open so retries keep hitting a failing provider. Internal CPU is 41% (baseline 39%) and the entire 8.1s latency is the provider call.

evidence.title: No deployment in the incident window (last release v3.4.1, 3 days ago)
evidence.detail: No checkout-web release in the last 72 hours. The v3.4.1 deploy is outside the correlation window and cannot explain a 07:05 incident.

evidence.title: Internal stores healthy: redis 52/100, postgres 61/200
evidence.detail: Neither the cache nor the database is anywhere near saturation, which contradicts the recalled pool-exhaustion precedents from payment-api and orders-api.

hint: Nothing internal is wrong. Choose a mitigation that bypasses or fails fast against the provider.

label: Service recovered (degraded mode)
description: Checkout flows again with fraud scoring deferred to async review.

evidence.title: Resolved: checkout confirm p95 610ms, 504 rate 0.1%
evidence.detail: Degraded mode enabled: fraud scoring skipped, orders flagged for async review, circuit breaker open for fraud-scoring-eu. No code change deployed.

hint: Stable with an accepted risk (async fraud review). Write up the lesson: never raise a timeout to fix a dead provider.
